notes.title: Added Demo Story
notes.notes: The game now has a playable story demo for players to enjoy. Among other small fixes.

notes.title: Dec-14 Update Notes
notes.notes: More balancing of power. Also adding the ability to play a demo of a story mode.

notes.title: It's cold outside. There's an ability the killers have now... They open doors.
notes.notes: Doors are openable and Sprint isn't exclusive to survivors no more.

notes.title: Killer buff
notes.notes: Fixed multiple bugs! Also added a sprint ability to killers and more bullets for survivors!!! Also updated the Main Menu!

notes.title: Version 1.0.0.2b
notes.notes: This version adds AI for those wanting a little bit more challenge. Also fixes issues with the previous build's Junkyard and Estillville maps.
